ns0:section.ns0:heading: Theft of major artwork

ns0:content.ns0:p: No person shall be prosecuted, tried, or punished for a violation of or conspiracy to violate section 668 unless the indictment is returned or the information is filed within 20 years after the commission of the offense.

ns0:section.ns0:sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 103–322, title XXXII, § 320902(b), Sept. 13, 1994, 108 Stat. 2124.)
